--- title: 01 · Data & graph construction --- Builds the bilateral edge list for `config.YEAR` from the raw BACI files, turns it into the directed weighted graph that every later notebook rebuilds, stores nodes and edges in DuckDB, and draws the flow map. The source, node set, and modelling decisions are on the [Data & method](../data.qmd) page. ::: {#1 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from __future__ import annotations import pandas as pd from eu_trade_network import config, data_loader, db, graph, viz ``` ::: ## Edge list + directed graph Build the bilateral edge list for `config.YEAR`, construct the directed weighted graph, and print a headline summary. ::: {#3 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} edgelist = data_loader.build_edgelist() G = graph.build_graph(edgelist) summary = graph.graph_summary(G) summary ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` {'n_nodes': 35.0, 'n_edges': 1190.0, 'density': 1.0, 'is_weakly_connected': 1.0, 'total_value_kusd': 9754928047.254004} ``` ::: ::: ## Persist nodes + edges in DuckDB ::: {#5 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} node_meta = ( pd.DataFrame([{"iso3": n, **attrs} for n, attrs in G.nodes(data=True)]) .sort_values("iso3") .reset_index(drop=True) ) node_meta["out_strength"] = [float(G.out_degree(n, weight="weight")) for n in node_meta["iso3"]] node_meta["in_strength"] = [float(G.in_degree(n, weight="weight")) for n in node_meta["iso3"]] node_meta["degree"] = [int(G.degree(n)) for n in node_meta["iso3"]] edges_db = edgelist.copy() edges_db["year"] = config.YEAR con = db.connect() db.init_schema(con) db.write_table( con, "nodes", node_meta[["iso3", "name", "grp", "out_strength", "in_strength", "degree"]], ) db.write_table(con, "edges", edges_db[["exporter_iso3", "importer_iso3", "value_kusd", "year"]]) print(f"Wrote {len(node_meta)} nodes and {len(edges_db)} edges → {config.DB_PATH}") con.close() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Wrote 35 nodes and 1190 edges → /home/emilia/projects/eu-trade-network/data/processed/trade.duckdb ``` ::: ::: ## Flow map (hero figure) ::: {#7 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Cartesian lon/lat map is kaleido-safe (no Plotly topojson CDN) and matches # the dark Quarto theme used for headline PNGs. fig = viz.plot_lonlat_flows( edgelist, node_meta, top_n=150, title=f"European merchandise trade flows {config.YEAR} (top 150 edges)", ) out = viz.save_fig(fig, "01_flow_map.png", headline=True) print(f"Saved {out}") fig.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Saved /home/emilia/projects/eu-trade-network/figures/headline/01_flow_map.png ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: :::
